State_change_caption: The sequence of images captures the progressive action of a cupboard being closed by a right-handed individual. Initially, the cupboard is open at a wide angle, inviting interaction. As the sequence progresses, the person's hand reaches for the cupboard handle and begins the motion to close it. The angle of the door decreases progressively with each frame, showing the door being drawn closer to the cabinet with the final image depicting the door nearly shut. Throughout this sequence, the pan on the stovetop remains a static element, contrasting with the dynamic closure of the cupboard.
